items.description: To achieve a well-defined scope, I have chosen to include publications on fuzzing from 4 top major security conferences (2008–2025): (i) Network and Distributed System Security Symposium (NDSS), (ii) IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P), (iii) USENIX Security Symposium (USEC), and (iv) ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS).
items.title: Papers

items.description: A curated collection of open-source fuzzing tools, organized by target category based on the taxonomy from fuzzing-survey.org. Tools are selected based on a combination of factors including GitHub popularity, recency, availability of official repositories from original authors, and whether the project is actively maintained.
items.title: Tools
AFL++
items.description: A superior fork to Google's AFL with more speed, more and better mutations, more and better instrumentation, and custom module support.

items.title: Angora
items.description: A mutation-based coverage guided fuzzer that increases branch coverage by solving path constraints without symbolic execution.

items.title: syzkaller
items.description: (2015) - An unsupervised coverage-guided kernel fuzzer supporting FreeBSD, Fuchsia, gVisor, Linux, NetBSD, OpenBSD, and Windows.

items.title: Trinity
items.description: (2012) - A Linux system call fuzzer that generates semi-intelligent random arguments to syscalls, including valid file descriptors, flags, and range-biased values.

items.title: kAFL
items.description: (2017) - A hardware-assisted x86-64 VM kernel fuzzing framework with performant VM reloads for finding OS kernel vulnerabilities.

items.title: DIFUZE
items.description: (2017) - An interface-aware fuzzer for Linux kernel drivers that automatically recovers ioctl interfaces via LLVM analysis and generates targeted test cases.

items.title: Razzer
items.description: (2019) - A kernel fuzzer that uses static analysis and two-phase fuzzing to detect race conditions and concurrency bugs in Linux kernels.

items.title: Janus
items.description: (2019) - A file system fuzzer that finds memory corruptions in Linux kernel file systems by mutating both filesystem images and syscall sequences simultaneously.

items.title: Hydra
items.description: (2019) - A fuzzing framework for automatically discovering semantic bugs in file systems using input mutators, feedback engines, and customizable checkers.

items.title: NTFuzz
items.description: (2021) - A type-aware Windows kernel fuzzer that statically analyzes system binaries to infer system call types for more effective fuzzing.

items.title: IMF
items.description: (2017) - A kernel API fuzzer that leverages automated API model inference to discover vulnerabilities in macOS kernel APIs.

items.title: ACTOR
items.description: (2023) - An action-guided kernel fuzzing framework that generates inputs leveraging triggered actions and their temporal relationships.

items.title: KRACE
items.description: (2020) - A coverage-guided fuzzing framework that detects data races in kernel file systems by exploring concurrency through multi-threaded syscall sequences.

items.title: FANS
items.description: A fuzzing tool for Android native system services with four components: interface collector, interface model extractor, dependency inferer, and fuzzer engine.

items.title: WuppieFuzz
items.description: A coverage-guided REST API fuzzer developed on top of LibAFL.

items.title: RestTestGen
items.description: A robust tool and framework designed for automated black-box testing of RESTful web APIs.

items.title: MINER
items.description: A REST API fuzzer that utilizes three data-driven designs working together to guide sequence generation, improve request generation quality, and capture unique errors caused by incorrect parameter usage.

items.title: Minerva
items.description: A browser fuzzer augmented by API mod-ref relations, aiming to synthesize highly-relevant browser API invocations in each test case.

items.title: GraphFuzz
items.description: An experimental framework for building structure-aware, library API fuzzers.

items.title: DifuzzRTL
items.description: A differential fuzz testing approach for CPU verification.

items.title: MorFuzz
items.description: A generic RISC-V processor fuzzing framework that can efficiently detect software triggerable functional bugs.

items.title: SpecFuzz
items.description: A tool to enable fuzzing for Spectre vulnerabilities.

items.title: Transynther
items.description: Automatically generates and tests building blocks for Meltdown attacks with various faults and microcode assists.

items.title: Witcher
items.description: A web application fuzzer that utilizes mutational fuzzing to explore web applications and fault escalation to detect command and SQL injection vulnerabilities.

items.title: TEFuzz
items.description: A tailored fuzzing-based framework to facilitate the detection and exploitation of template escape bugs.

items.title: CorbFuzz
items.description: A state-aware fuzzer for generating as many responses from a web application as possible without need of setting up a database.

items.title: Fluffy
items.description: A multi-transaction differential fuzzer for finding consensus bugs in Ethereum.

items.title: LOKI
items.description: A Blockchain consensus protocol fuzzing framework that detects consensus memory related and logic bugs.
